scope: Hand-reviewed public product manual; fixed UI/document provenance hashes only, not arbitrary repository retrieval.

zh.title: FinPilot 使用起点
zh.summary: FinPilot 是面向学习的中英双语金融助手，组合聊天、固定公式计算、期权互动学习与样本分析、专家依据及 2D 桌宠。
steps: 第一次接触期权可先打开「期权互动学习」（/learn），从三个明确标为合成的教学情景观察线索，再改变到期价格或策略，查看本地试算。
需要进一步解释时，在学习页明确保存当前演示并进入独立追问会话；核对草稿、语言与回答引擎后点击发送。打开页面、试算、保存和进入聊天不会自动调用模型或 IBKR。
在完整工作台可以自由聊天、使用计算器、专业期权采集及历史复盘；已有三步演示仍可回放已保存的真实历史档案并明确请求 AI 解释。
每条分析或回答都应核对实际模式、数据日期、数值与来源，区分合成教学、真实历史和实际收到的行情类型。
restrictions: 项目不会自动交易、后台轮询行情或保证判断正确。
普通科学、编程与生活问题也可正常提问；项目使用教程与市场事实是不同来源。
加载本地档案、播放动画或连接桌宠本身不触发模型调用。

en.title: Start using FinPilot
en.summary: FinPilot is a bilingual educational finance assistant combining chat, fixed-formula calculators, interactive options learning and sample analysis, expert evidence and a 2D desktop companion.
steps: New to options? Open Interactive options learning (/learn): inspect three clearly synthetic teaching scenarios, change the expiry price or strategy, and read the local trial.

For an explanation, explicitly save the current demo and enter its separate follow-up conversation. Review the draft, language and engine before selecting Send. Opening the page, calculating, saving and entering chat do not automatically call a model or IBKR.

The full workspace retains general chat, calculators, professional options collection and historical review. The existing three-step demo still replays a saved real historical archive before an explicit AI explanation.
Check the actual mode, data dates, numbers and sources on each analysis or answer. Distinguish synthetic teaching data, real historical records and the feed type actually received.
restrictions: The project does not place trades, poll quotes in the background or guarantee correct conclusions.
Ordinary science, programming and daily-life questions remain available; product tutorials are separate from market evidence.
Loading an archive, playing an animation or connecting the pet does not itself call a model.

zh.title: 使用期权分析
zh.summary: 从所选合约样本出发，先核对数据时间与覆盖，再看分布、可比性和冲突线索。
steps: 新手先打开「期权互动学习」（/learn），用三个合成情景观察成交分布、报价差和保护成本，再试算到期盈亏；这里不是实际市场行情。
打开侧栏「期权分析」，填写公司或基金代码；到期日从该标的实际期权链读取。
可选「把几个标的或日期放在一起比较」，每行一组，最多 4 组；在高级设置调整范围和请求行情类型。
点击「帮我读懂这批期权」后先看「易懂解读」，需要时展开「专业详情」和诊断；要继续聊天，点击「针对这批数据追问」并发送问题。
restrictions: 网关采集需要可用 IB Gateway/API 连接与相应行情权限；请求实时不代表实际收到实时。
勾选「让 AI 补充解释」才会把汇总指标发给模型；需遵守行情许可。
样本成交或持仓比例不是多空人数，不能单独证明全市场情绪或预测涨跌；缺失报价不会补造。

en.title: Use options analysis
en.summary: Start with the selected contract sample: check timing and coverage before distributions, comparability and conflicting clues.
steps: Start with Interactive options learning (/learn) if you are new: inspect volume distribution, quote width and protection cost in three synthetic scenarios, then try an expiry-payoff calculation. These are not market quotes.
Open Options analysis in the sidebar and enter a stock or fund symbol. Expirations come from that symbol’s actual option chain.
Choose comparison mode for several symbols or dates: one group per line, up to four. Advanced settings control the strike range and requested feed type.
Select the analysis button, read Plain-language view first, then inspect Technical details and diagnostics. To continue in chat, choose the report follow-up button and send a question.
restrictions: Gateway collection requires an available IB Gateway/API connection and appropriate market-data permissions. Requesting live data does not establish that live data arrived.
Selecting AI interpretation sends aggregate metrics to a model; market-data licence conditions still apply.
Sample volume or open-interest shares are not counts of bullish or bearish people and do not alone establish market-wide sentiment or predict prices. Missing quotes remain missing.

zh.title: 期权互动学习与到期盈亏试算
zh.summary: 在 /learn 用三个合成教学情景先读线索，再做本地到期试算；需要解释时显式保存同一份演示并进入独立聊天。
steps: 打开「期权互动学习」（/learn），选择看跌活动集中、报价变宽或看跌保护更贵的情景。先读观察、数字依据与局限，需要时展开专业数据。
核对合成记录的教学日期 2026-11-09 至 2026-11-11、报价展示时间 2026-11-11 21:00 UTC 与假设到期日 2026-12-18；这些日期不是采集真实行情的证明。
在「想了解的结构」选择买入看涨、买入看跌或看涨借记价差；选择行权价，填写 1–10 份合约及 0–1000 USD 的假设标的到期价格。合约乘数固定为 100，价差保持同到期、等数量两腿，卖出腿行权价高于买入腿。
权利金可选按买卖报价（自然价：买入使用 ask、卖出使用 bid），或按 bid/ask 中间价。点击「更新本地试算」，比较整组成本、到期盈亏、盈亏平衡价格及最大损失；中间价并不保证能成交。
若要问助手，先核对当前试算，再点击「保存这份演示」；点击「带着这份演示追问」也会先保存，再建立独立会话并绑定该报告。进入聊天只填好问题草稿，核对后明确点击发送；不会覆盖原有聊天会话。
改变参数不会改写已保存报告或旧回答；更新试算后须保存新版本。真实历史档案、自己的文件及 IBKR 专业采集分别从完整工作台的历史复盘和期权分析进入。
restrictions: 三个情景、报价、IV 与活动数字均为预设合成教学数据，不代表实时或历史市场证据。成交占比不是看空人数，报价变宽或保护较贵也不能单独预测涨跌。
结果是保持完整组合的理想化到期现金盈亏，不是到期前平仓估值或概率预测；不模拟行权、指派、提前行权、分腿处理、手续费、税费、融资、股息和滑点。买入看涨的理论最大收益无上限，图表最高点不等于最大收益。
打开学习页、切换情景、更新本地试算、保存演示和建立追问会话都不请求 LLM 或 IBKR；只有在聊天里明确发送问题才使用所选回答引擎，离线模式仍可读取已保存的试算依据。
学习页不下单、不自动刷新行情、不自动发送聊天，也不把合成日期标成真实行情采集时间。

en.title: Interactive options learning and expiry-payoff trials
en.summary: Use three synthetic teaching scenarios at /learn to inspect clues and calculate local expiry payoffs; explicitly save the same demo before opening a separate follow-up conversation.
steps: Open Interactive options learning (/learn). Choose concentrated put activity, wider quotes, or more expensive put protection. Read the observations, numeric evidence and limits before expanding the detailed data.

Check the synthetic teaching dates, 2026-11-09 through 2026-11-11, the quote-display timestamp 2026-11-11 21:00 UTC, and assumed expiry 2026-12-18. These timestamps do not establish that market data was collected.

Choose a long call, long put or call debit spread. Select strikes, enter 1–10 contracts and an assumed underlying price at expiry from 0–1000 USD. The multiplier is fixed at 100. A spread uses equal-quantity legs with the same expiry and a higher short-call strike.

Choose natural bid/ask pricing (buy at ask, sell at bid) or the bid/ask midpoint. Select Update local trial and compare total-position cost, expiry P/L, break-even price and maximum loss. Midpoint fills are not guaranteed.

To ask the assistant, inspect the current trial and select Save this demo. Ask about this demo also saves it first, creates a separate conversation and binds that report. Entering chat only prefills a draft: review it and explicitly select Send. Existing conversations are not replaced.

Editing inputs does not rewrite a saved report or old answers; save a new version after updating the trial. Real historical archives, file imports and professional IBKR collection remain in the workspace history and options views.
restrictions: All three scenarios, quotes, IV and activity numbers are authored synthetic teaching data, not evidence of current or historical market conditions. Put-volume share is not a count of bearish people; wide quotes or expensive protection alone do not predict direction.

Results are idealized expiry cash payoffs for an intact position, not pre-expiry closing valuations or probability forecasts. Exercise, assignment, early exercise, legging, fees, taxes, financing, dividends and slippage are excluded. A long call has theoretically unlimited maximum gain; the highest plotted point is not that maximum.

Opening the page, switching scenarios, recalculating, saving and creating a follow-up conversation make no LLM or IBKR request. The selected answer engine is used only after an explicit chat send; offline replies can still read saved trial evidence.
The learning page places no trades, starts no automatic market refresh and sends no automatic chat message. Synthetic dates are not labelled as real quote-collection times.

zh.title: 导入与回放历史资料
zh.summary: 历史复盘在本地核对指定合约的历史记录；它不是即时行情或完整期权链。
steps: 进入「期权分析 → 历史复盘与专家依据」；可以回放真实 IBKR 历史样本，或加载明确标为合成的教学样例。
导入自己的文件时先下载 CSV/JSON 模板，填写名称、代码、到期日并选择 UTF-8 文件；核对预览与来源说明。
CSV 至少提供 trading_date、strike、right，C 为看涨、P 为看跌。点击「生成本地历史复盘」，再选择「带着这段历史追问」，核对草稿后发送。
restrictions: 接受 2–300 行，文件或转换后的请求最多 32000 字节；仅支持 USD、标准乘数 100，空值不填成零。
本地文件来源未独立核验；真实样本回放不访问网关，教学样例不是市场证据。
所收盘中成交 bar 末值不是官方收盘或结算价；时段覆盖未核验、历史 OI 或独立统计日期缺失时不得强行比较。
界面没有历史网关抓取表单；历史读取 API 的存在不代表已有相应网页按钮。

en.title: Import or replay historical records
en.summary: Historical review checks selected contracts locally; it is neither live market data nor a complete option chain.
steps: Open Options analysis → Historical review & expert evidence. Replay a saved real IBKR sample, or load the clearly labelled synthetic teaching example.
For your own data, download a CSV/JSON template, enter a review name, symbol and expiration, choose a UTF-8 file, then inspect the preview and provenance notes.
CSV requires trading_date, strike and right; use C for call and P for put. Build the local review, choose its follow-up action, review the draft and select Send.
restrictions: Use 2–300 rows and no more than 32000 bytes for the file or converted request. Only USD with standard multiplier 100 is supported; missing values are not zero-filled.
Local-file provenance is not independently verified. Saved-sample replay makes no gateway request; teaching data is not market evidence.
Received intraday trade-bar end values are not official closes or settlement prices. Unverified session coverage, missing historical OI or reporting dates can prevent comparisons.
There is no historical gateway-fetch form in this UI; a historical-read API is not evidence of a corresponding page button.

zh.title: 针对报告追问与刷新
zh.summary: 聊天会读取服务器当前绑定的报告；旧回复保留各自的数据时间、来源与证据。
steps: 在分析结果选择追问，将该报告绑定到会话，再发送容易理解的问题，例如「哪些能确定，哪些仍不确定？」。
快照报告卡可点击「刷新并解释变化」：按原来保存的范围和请求模式重新采集，再解释可比的前后变化。
展开分析记录查看旧版本；在工作台或桌宠继续提问时使用当前绑定，明确切换报告才改变绑定。
restrictions: 追问本身不自动刷新行情。历史复盘固定，不能用实时刷新按钮更新；导入另一批记录可创建新版本。
新报告提交后即保留；模型解释失败不代表报告未保存。缺失字段、样本范围变化或统计时点不一致会标为不可比。
本地接收时间变化不等于交易所行情变化；旧报告、旧回答不会被改成新数据。

en.title: Ask about a report and refresh it
en.summary: Chat reads the report currently bound on the server; earlier answers retain their own timestamps, sources and evidence.
steps: Choose the report follow-up action to bind it to a chat, then send a plain-language question such as “What is established and what is still uncertain?”.
On a snapshot card, choose Refresh and explain changes to collect the saved scope and requested feed mode again, then explain comparable changes.
Expand analysis history to revisit earlier versions. Workspace and pet follow-ups use the current binding; change reports explicitly when needed.
restrictions: A follow-up does not automatically refresh quotes. Historical reviews stay fixed and cannot use live refresh; import another dataset for a new version.
A committed new report is retained even if model explanation fails. Missing fields, changed samples or inconsistent reporting times can make comparisons invalid.
A newer local receipt time does not prove the market changed. Earlier reports and answers retain their original evidence.

zh.title: 切换回答引擎
zh.summary: 选择 DeepSeek 或可用的本地 LoRA 作为后续问题的引擎；“已配置”只是服务器设置状态，不等于接口连通或账户额度已验证，应核对每条回答的实际模式和错误。
steps: 在工作台聊天输入框上方打开「回答引擎」下拉框，选择可用引擎；切换作用于下一条问题。
桌宠聊天气泡也有引擎选择；共享连接的语言和引擎会同步到已明确连接的会话。
若本地引擎未就绪，核对可选 LoRA 环境、缓存基座和适配器，再重启后端；以可用状态与实际回答标记为准。
restrictions: DeepSeek 需要服务器可用配置；密钥只在后端，不应贴到聊天框。
本地引擎依赖独立 Python/ML 环境、已缓存基座、训练清单和权重；不会在普通聊天中自动下载模型。
缺少模型或生成失败会显示实际降级提示；有本地金融资料时可展示摘录，项目使用教程仍可阅读。没有一般问题的本地资料时不会编造答案。

en.title: Switch answer engines
en.summary: Choose DeepSeek or an available local LoRA engine for later questions. “Configured” describes server settings, not verified connectivity or account credit; check each reply’s actual mode and errors.
steps: Open the Answer engine selector above the workspace input and choose an available engine. The choice applies to the next question.
The pet chat bubble also has an engine selector. Language and engine preferences synchronize for the explicitly connected chat.
If the local engine is not ready, check the optional LoRA environment, cached base model and adapter, then restart the backend. Trust availability and actual answer badges.
restrictions: DeepSeek requires working server configuration. Credentials stay on the backend and should not be pasted into chat.
The local engine needs a separate Python/ML environment, cached base model, training manifest and weights. Ordinary chat does not download models automatically.

Missing models or generation failures show the actual fallback. Available local finance references and project-manual steps remain readable; an ordinary question without local references is not given an invented local answer.

zh.title: 连接和使用 2D 桌宠
zh.summary: 小鲸与工作台共用已明确选定的聊天和金融后端；网页预览与 Windows 原生宿主的能力不同。
steps: 在工作台新建或打开目标会话，在助手区域点击「连接当前会话」；桌宠只同步明确连接的会话。
项目主启动器会自动打开 Windows 悬浮 2D 助手；start-desktop.ps1 可启动同一项目而不打开浏览器。双击角色或按回车打开聊天，单击只播放本地互动。
聊天气泡可追问报告或打开计算器、历史复盘和完整工作台；菜单可调整大小、恢复位置或隐藏，Windows 托盘可恢复与退出。
不再共享时点击「断开」；删除被连接会话或重启服务也会清除连接。
restrictions: 切换另一网页会话不会让桌宠自动跟随；关闭浏览器后，本地后端仍运行时桌宠可继续该会话。
便携 EXE 仍需要项目 Python 环境和后端；浏览器 /pet 预览不具备系统置顶、托盘或原生点击穿透。
鲸鱼娘是非官方 2D 角色，仅用于课程及个人非商业演示；动画状态不表示市场涨跌或判断可靠性。
原生宿主不提供麦克风语音输入；漫游默认关闭，动画、连接与 SSE 重连不自动请求模型或行情。
关闭项目启动窗口、按 Ctrl+C 或执行 stop-finpilot.cmd 会一起停止本次后端和助手；后端退出也会关闭助手。只关闭浏览器不停止项目；托盘「退出桌宠」只关闭助手。独立启动的旧服务不会被接管。

en.title: Connect and use the 2D pet
en.summary: The pet shares an explicitly selected chat and the existing finance backend. Browser preview and Windows native host have different capabilities.
steps: Open or create the intended workspace chat and select Connect current chat in the companion panel. Only that explicitly connected chat is synchronized.

The main project launcher automatically opens the Windows floating 2D assistant. start-desktop.ps1 starts the same project without opening a browser. Double-click the character or press Enter to open chat; a single click plays only a local interaction.
Use its bubble for report questions or shortcuts to calculators, history and the full workspace. Its menu controls size, position and hiding; the Windows tray restores or exits it.
Select Disconnect when finished. Deleting the linked chat or restarting the service also clears the connection.
restrictions: Switching to another web chat does not silently move the pet. It can continue after the browser closes while the local backend remains running.
The portable EXE still requires the project Python environment and backend. Browser /pet preview has no native always-on-top, tray or system click-through capability.
The unofficial whale maid is 2D and limited to course/personal noncommercial demonstrations. Animation states do not indicate market direction or confidence.
The native host does not offer microphone input. Roaming defaults off; animation, connection and SSE reconnection do not automatically request models or market data.

Closing the project launch window, pressing Ctrl+C or running stop-finpilot.cmd stops its backend and assistant together. Backend exit also closes the assistant. Closing a browser leaves the project running; tray Quit pet closes only the assistant. Separately started services are not taken over.

zh.title: 导出聊天记录
zh.summary: 工作台提供当前会话的 JSON 下载，包含已保存的回答及其分析依据。
steps: 在侧栏打开要保留的会话，等待当前请求结束。
点击输入框下方「导出会话」，浏览器会下载该会话的 JSON 文件。
保留文件时自行检查内容；需要其他格式可在项目外转换。
restrictions: 当前没有 PDF、Word、Excel 或图片导出按钮，也没有导入聊天 JSON 的界面。
导出的是当前会话，不是自动打包所有会话；不要将包含私人信息的文件公开。

en.title: Export a chat
en.summary: The workspace downloads the current chat as JSON, including saved answers and their analysis evidence.
steps: Open the desired chat in the sidebar and wait for any current request to finish.
Select Export chat below the composer; the browser downloads that chat’s JSON file.
Review the file before sharing. Convert to other formats outside the project if needed.
restrictions: There is no PDF, Word, Excel or image export button, nor a chat-JSON import UI.
Export covers the current chat, not an automatic bundle of every chat. Avoid publishing files containing private information.

zh.title: 语音输入与朗读
zh.summary: 工作台利用浏览器提供的语音识别与朗读能力，不下载额外语音模型。
steps: 在工作台点击输入框旁「语音输入」，允许浏览器麦克风权限；识别文字只填入草稿，核对后再发送。
已有回答可用朗读操作，助手面板有「朗读最新回答」；再次停止或取消时以界面状态为准。
若按钮不可用或识别失败，检查浏览器能力、权限与设备，或直接键盘输入。
restrictions: 语音识别支持取决于浏览器，可能使用浏览器厂商在线服务；硬件与语言支持不保证。
朗读使用浏览器 speechSynthesis，声线取决于设备；角色嘴部动画不是精准音素同步。
Windows 桌宠宿主不开放麦克风，桌宠气泡没有工作台语音按钮；不可据此宣传原生语音对话。

en.title: Voice input and read-aloud
en.summary: The workspace uses browser speech recognition and synthesis without downloading an additional voice model.
steps: Select Voice input beside the workspace composer and allow microphone access. Recognition fills a draft only; review it before selecting Send.
Use a saved answer’s read-aloud action or Read latest answer in the companion panel. Follow the displayed state to stop or cancel speech.
If unavailable or failing, check browser capability, permissions and devices, or type the question.
restrictions: Recognition depends on browser support and may use a browser-vendor online service. Hardware and language support are not guaranteed.
Read-aloud uses browser speechSynthesis and device voices. Character mouth motion is not precise phoneme synchronization.
The Windows native pet does not grant microphone access and its bubble lacks the workspace voice buttons; it is not native voice conversation.

zh.title: 切换 2D/3D 展示形象
zh.summary: 默认鲸鱼娘采用真实多帧 2D 图集；旧机器人仍提供 2D SVG 与 3D WebGL 展示。
steps: 在工作台助手区域的「展示形象」中选择「鲸鱼娘 · 2D」或「原有机器人 · 2D/3D」。
需要 3D 时先选择旧机器人，再使用 3D/2D 按钮；鲸鱼娘没有 3D 模型。
使用「减少动态」或系统减少动画设置降低运动；资源不可用时保留静态或 2D 降级与聊天功能。
restrictions: 3D 依赖 WebGL2/浏览器能力；不是所有设备都能启用。
待机、聆听、思考、朗读、错误只表示实际操作状态，不表示投资回报或市场情绪。
/demo 共用角色组件，但保持独立会话，不自动读取桌宠或工作台聊天。

en.title: Switch 2D/3D appearances
en.summary: The default whale maid uses a real multi-frame 2D atlas. The legacy robot retains 2D SVG and 3D WebGL displays.
steps: In the workspace companion panel choose Whale maid · 2D or Legacy robot · 2D/3D from Appearance.
For 3D, first select the legacy robot, then use its 3D/2D controls. The whale maid has no 3D model.
Use Reduce motion or the system preference to limit movement. Static/2D fallbacks preserve chat when rendering assets fail.
restrictions: 3D requires WebGL2/browser support and is unavailable on some devices.
Idle, listening, thinking, speaking and error indicate operations, not returns or market sentiment.
The demo shares the character component but keeps its own chat and does not automatically read pet or workspace conversations.

zh.title: 交易能力边界
zh.summary: FinPilot 没有自动交易、下单或代客执行功能；IBKR 集成用于只读行情与历史数据分析。
steps: 把项目用于核对数据、学习期权概念和解释样本证据。
需要投资决策时自行核查时效、缺失项和风险，不把模型或角色动画当作买卖指令。
restrictions: 不会读取订单、持仓或账户资产来执行交易，也没有一键买卖、回测交易执行或收益保证。
界面可连接网关不等于具有交易权限；不能通过聊天开启未实现的交易能力。

en.title: Trading capability boundary
en.summary: FinPilot has no automatic trading, order placement or execution-on-your-behalf feature. Its IBKR integration reads market and historical data for analysis.
steps: Use the project to inspect data, learn option concepts and explain sample evidence.
Independently check timing, missing fields and risks for decisions; model replies and character animations are not trade instructions.
restrictions: It does not read orders, positions or account assets to execute trades. There is no one-click trade execution, execution backtest or return guarantee.
Connecting a gateway does not establish trading capability. Chat cannot enable an unimplemented order feature.

zh.title: 区分网关、订阅与延迟数据问题
zh.summary: 以报告中的请求模式、实际返回类型、字段覆盖和安全诊断区分问题；程序不能授予缺少的订阅。
steps: 确认 IB Gateway 已登录、启用 socket API 并与后端所配置的本地端口一致，保留只读设置；不要把密码、账号或验证码发到聊天。
在期权分析的高级设置明确选择实时、冻结、延迟或延迟冻结，再查看实际行情类型和字段覆盖；需要时缩小范围重试。
若存在订阅提示，在 IBKR 客户门户核对当前登录环境的行情权限、API acknowledgement 和模拟账户共享；没有实时权限时可使用可用历史档案学习。
restrictions: 354 是本次请求的订阅限制；10090 可表示部分字段限制；10167 需结合实际延迟类型与字段，不能说全部接口失效。
具体缺少哪一款订阅必须核对账户当前权限；本项目未读取你的订阅清单，不能保证购买某产品即可修复全部字段。
close 参考价不等于双边 bid/ask，延迟或冻结不等于实时；超时本身也不能唯一证明权限或程序故障。
这里给配置检查步骤，不会自动连接、订阅、购买套餐或请求新行情。

en.title: Separate gateway, subscription and delayed-data issues
en.summary: Use the requested mode, actual returned type, field coverage and safe diagnostics. The program cannot grant a missing subscription.
steps: Check that IB Gateway is logged in, socket API is enabled and its local port matches the backend configuration; keep read-only settings. Do not send passwords, account details or codes to chat.
In options advanced settings explicitly select live, frozen, delayed or delayed-frozen, then inspect actual type and field coverage. Reduce the sampling range if needed.
For entitlement notices, check market-data permissions, API acknowledgement and paper-account sharing in the IBKR portal for the current login environment. Saved history remains usable for learning.
restrictions: 354 identifies a subscription restriction for that request. 10090 can indicate partial field restrictions. Interpret 10167 with actual delayed type and received fields, not as proof of total interface failure.
The exact missing product requires checking current account permissions. The project has not read your subscriptions and cannot promise a particular purchase will fix every field.
A close reference is not two-sided bid/ask; delayed or frozen is not live. A timeout alone cannot uniquely identify permissions or a software fault.
These are configuration checks, not automatic connections, subscription purchases or new market-data requests.

zh.title: 使用固定公式计算器
zh.summary: 计算器提供复利储蓄、固定利率等额本息贷款和月度收支预算，数值由本地固定公式计算。
steps: 打开侧栏「财务计算器」或输入框旁「计算」，选择复利储蓄、贷款月供或收支预算。
填入界面要求的本金、利率、期限、月末追加或收支等参数，再点击「计算结果」。
利率输入框以百分数为单位：年利率 5% 填 5，不填 0.05；预算的收入与支出应按同一月份和币种填写。
查看结果、公式和假设，修改参数比较不同计划。
restrictions: 复利采用月度复利与月末追加假设；贷款采用固定利率等额本息，不代表银行实际报价。
没有期权定价、税务、保险、保证收益或实盘回测计算器；聊天中的精确计算应核对工具结果。
执行本地计算不需要模型或 IBKR 请求。

en.title: Use fixed-formula calculators
en.summary: The calculator covers compound savings, fixed-rate amortizing loan payments and monthly budgets using deterministic local formulas.
steps: Open Financial calculators in the sidebar or Calculate beside the composer. Choose savings, loan payment or budget.
Enter the displayed principal, rate, term, month-end contributions or income/expense parameters and select Calculate.
Rate inputs use percentage points: enter 5 for a 5% annual rate, not 0.05. Budget income and expenses should use the same month and currency.
Inspect results, formulas and assumptions; change inputs to compare plans.
restrictions: Savings assume monthly compounding and month-end contributions. Loans assume a fixed-rate amortizing schedule, not a bank quote.
There is no option-pricing, tax, insurance, guaranteed-return or live-trading backtest calculator. Check precise chat calculations against tool results.
Local calculations do not require a model or IBKR request.

zh.title: 微调、RAG 与本地 LoRA 的区别
zh.summary: 本项目的专家 RAG 是检索已审阅知识来支持解释；本地 Qwen3-0.6B LoRA 是单独的微调实验，二者不是同一件事。
steps: 在演示页加载历史样本并查看专家依据，观察本地数据来源与专家知识来源分开显示。
RAG 用词项 BM25、中文字符匹配与 RRF 排序，不使用 embeddings 或向量数据库；相关性分数不是判断正确率。
若已准备本地 LoRA 环境与权重，可在引擎选择器选择本地实验，并核对回答实际模式。
restrictions: 没有对托管 DeepSeek 做微调；提示词、检索知识或风格包装不能称作 DeepSeek 微调。
LoRA 依赖可选环境、缓存基座和适配器；小样本训练/检索指标不等于金融事实准确率或超过 DeepSeek。
来源主张检查是有限规则，不是通用语义证明；检索和引用都不能保证预测成功。

en.title: Fine-tuning, RAG and the local LoRA experiment
en.summary: Expert RAG retrieves reviewed knowledge to support explanations. Local Qwen3-0.6B LoRA is a separate fine-tuning experiment.
steps: Load a historical sample in the demo and inspect expert evidence; local data and expert knowledge sources are displayed separately.
RAG ranks BM25 terms and Chinese character matches with RRF; it uses no embeddings or vector database. Relevance scores are not accuracy estimates.
With the optional local LoRA environment and weights prepared, choose the local experiment in the engine selector and inspect its actual answer mode.
restrictions: The hosted DeepSeek model was not fine-tuned. Prompts, retrieval and styling must not be called DeepSeek fine-tuning.
LoRA requires optional dependencies, a cached base model and adapter. Small-sample training/retrieval metrics do not establish financial accuracy or superiority to DeepSeek.
Claim-source checks are limited rules, not general semantic proof. Retrieval and citations do not guarantee successful predictions.

zh.title: 会话、语言和普通问答
zh.summary: 工作台保存会话与回答依据；金融之外的普通问题也可使用所选模型回答。
steps: 点击顶部「新建会话」或侧栏加号开始新聊天，从「最近会话」恢复已有会话。
使用顶部语言按钮切换中文与英文；模型选择位于输入框上方，当前请求期间部分控件会锁定。
不再需要某条会话时使用该会话的删除操作；删除连接中的会话会断开桌宠共享。
restrictions: 发送请求才调用所选模型；离线摘录与模型调用有不同模式标记。
不会自动把所有会话共享给桌宠；/demo 使用独立会话规则。
删除会话不会把以前的模型回答改写为新的分析依据；如需保留记录请先导出。

en.title: Chats, languages and ordinary questions
en.summary: The workspace saves chats and answer evidence. Ordinary questions beyond finance can also use the selected model.
steps: Select New chat at the top or the sidebar plus button; restore existing chats from Recent chats.
Use the top language button for Chinese/English. The engine selector is above the input; some controls lock during a request.
Delete an unwanted chat using its session action. Deleting the connected chat also disconnects the pet.
restrictions: Only sending a request invokes the selected model. Offline excerpts and model calls have distinct mode badges.
The app does not automatically share all chats with the pet. The demo keeps separate session rules.
Deletion does not rewrite old answers with new analysis evidence. Export first if you need a copy.

zh.title: 主题与减少动态
zh.summary: 工作台默认浅白、藏青与低调金色，保留主题切换和减少动态控制。
steps: 点击工作台顶部主题按钮切换明暗显示。
点击「减少动态」或助手区域相应选项；系统减少动画偏好也会参与显示设置。
移动端使用导航按钮与可折叠助手面板，必要时先关闭工具弹窗再回到聊天。
restrictions: 减少动态只影响展示，不更改市场数据或模型判断。
透明、WebGL、语音与帧率取决于浏览器和设备；截图或模拟视口不等于所有真实硬件认证。

en.title: Themes and reduced motion
en.summary: The workspace defaults to white, navy and restrained gold, with theme and reduced-motion controls.
steps: Use the top theme button to switch light/dark display.
Select Reduce motion or the matching companion option; system motion preferences also affect rendering.
On small screens use the navigation button and collapsible companion panel, closing tool dialogs when returning to chat.
restrictions: Reduced motion changes presentation, not market data or model conclusions.
Transparency, WebGL, speech and frame rate depend on the device/browser. Screenshots or simulated viewports do not certify all physical hardware.

zh.title: 未确认的项目功能
zh.summary: 这份已审阅手册未确认所问功能，不能据此声称已经实现或可在当前环境使用。
steps: 查看工作台已有的聊天、计算器、期权分析与历史复盘入口；也可打开 API 文档核对现有契约。
请说明想完成的操作和当前页面，便于区分已有入口、环境依赖与尚需开发的能力。
restrictions: 未知不等于支持；没有已核实的入口时不会编造按钮、菜单、路径或操作成功。
手册不读取账户订阅、私有文件、密钥或任意代码，也不执行安装、购买、交易或电脑操作。

en.title: Unconfirmed project capability
en.summary: The reviewed manual does not establish the requested feature. It cannot be represented as implemented or available in this environment.
steps: Inspect the existing workspace chat, calculators, options and history entries, or use API documentation to check the current contract.
Describe the action you want and the current page so existing controls, environment dependencies and future work can be distinguished.
restrictions: Unknown does not mean supported. No unverified button, menu, path or successful operation is invented.
The manual does not read account subscriptions, private files, credentials or arbitrary code, or execute installations, purchases, trades or computer actions.
